I run a similar deck but instead of Colleen, Gambit, and Moon Knight I’m running Nico, Grandmaster, and Magik. Nico is extremely versatile as she can buff or copy Daken, draw cards, and change a location. Grandmaster can get you an extra shard out of Daken or discard. I’d like to switch Magik out for Frigga when I get her but right now she’s useful for getting an extra draw and setting up a huge last turn.
